### Failure is Not Final
Author: Pastor Jeff Schreve
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/fromhisheart/from-his-heart-week-of-august-10.html
Passage: Proverbs 24:16
Points:
- Stumbling into sin or making a wrong turn does not mean your life's journey is over.
- God treats believers with patience, gently redirecting them back into His path rather than discarding them.
- Lasting joy and peace are found by submitting to God's guidance instead of choosing rebellion.
- Because failure is not final, a righteous person can repeatedly get back up by God's grace.

### Bedrock - Today's Insight - March 5, 2022
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-march-5-2022.html
Passage: Proverbs 24:3-4
Points:
- Domestic disharmony can turn a place of rest and refuge into a painful daily battlefield.
- Establishing a stable home requires deep discernment rather than superficial problem-solving.
- True biblical wisdom involves knowing God personally and translating that relationship into practical living.
- Committing to obey Scripture as the final authority protects a household from self-destruction.
